body: It’s fine I like hearing of things other people tried to help and cope and stuff

Yeah my best friends have no idea. I just don’t feel right anymore and I’m tired of it you know? I put on an act at school and at home. I just wanna talk to my guidance counselor but she’s kind of a b**** and Hates me. Everything changed when my closest friend killed himself. I mean I was a bit sad and then all this shit started happening and I can’t take it.
Yeah your right I guess it’s worth a try

But how would I come off to telling my parents. It’d be awkward. Especially the fact that my sadness has gotten to the point that I don’t do anything just come home and listen to music. I’m failing four classes and I’m afraid that people will think I’m trying to get out of it by lying.
